protocol: causal_structure_learning_v1: Block-5 minimal experiment. Hidden confounder C->X,C->Y makes X and Y correlated while do(X) has no effect on Y. correlational uses P(Y|X) from passive data (misled by the confounded association); interventional calibrates P(Y|do(X)) from a small number of intervention samples. Criterion: interventional error <= 0.15 and >= 0.15 lower than correlational -- intervention-verifiable causal learning is realizable.
